disableContextCaching.desc: The cost of generating a single conversation can be reduced by up to 90%, and the response speed is increased by 4 times (<1>Learn more</1>). Enabling this will automatically disable the limit on the number of historical messages.
disableContextCaching.title: Enable Context Caching

enableReasoning.desc: Based on the Claude Thinking mechanism limit (<1>Learn more</1>), enabling this will automatically disable the limit on the number of historical messages.
enableReasoning.title: Enable Deep Thinking

deepSeekReasoning.desc: Let DeepSeek V4 run internal chain-of-thought before answering. Turn off for faster, cheaper replies.
deepSeekReasoning.title: Enable Deep Thinking

deepSeekReasoningEffort.desc: Use maximum reasoning effort (max) for complex questions. Increases latency and token usage.
deepSeekReasoningEffort.title: Max Reasoning Effort

kimiReasoning.desc: Let Kimi K2.5 / K2.6 run internal chain-of-thought before answering. Turn off for faster, cheaper replies. Use the matching model ID.
kimiReasoning.title: Enable Deep Thinking

moonshotPreservedReasoning.desc: kimi-k2.6 only: keep prior turns' reasoning_content in context (Preserved Thinking). Enable together with deep thinking; increases tokens and cost.
moonshotPreservedReasoning.title: Preserved thinking (K2.6)

minimaxReasoningSplit.desc: When on (default), interleaved thinking is split into reasoning_details (MiniMax OpenAI-compatible reasoning_split). When off, behavior follows MiniMax server defaults; keep full assistant turns for multi-turn tool use.
minimaxReasoningSplit.title: Split thinking vs answer (reasoning_split)

reasoningBudgetToken.adaptiveHint: Thinking budget scales automatically with task difficulty.
reasoningBudgetToken.adaptiveOnlyHint: This model only supports adaptive thinking.
reasoningBudgetToken.fixedBudgetHint: Set a fixed thinking token budget between 1k and 64k.
reasoningBudgetToken.title: Thinking Consumption Token

reasoningEffort.descAnthropic: When extended thinking is on and the request uses Claude adaptive thinking, maps to API `output_config.effort` (low / medium / high).
reasoningEffort.title: Reasoning Intensity

urlContext.desc: When enabled, web links will be automatically parsed to retrieve the actual webpage context content
urlContext.title: Extract Webpage Link Content

zhipuPreservedThinking.desc: Keep prior turns' reasoning_content in context (Preserved Thinking, clear_thinking=false) to improve multi-turn reasoning. Enable together with deep thinking; increases tokens and cost.
zhipuPreservedThinking.title: Preserved Thinking (GLM)

zhipuReasoning.desc: When on, GLM-5.x / 4.5+ performs internal chain-of-thought reasoning before answering; turning it off is faster and cheaper.
zhipuReasoning.title: Enable Deep Thinking (GLM)

zhipuReasoningEffort.desc: GLM-5.2+ only. max = deep reasoning (default), high = enhanced reasoning, skip = bypass thinking (maps to API none). Only effective when thinking is enabled.
zhipuReasoningEffort.title: Reasoning Effort (reasoning_effort)
